title: Recurrent processing mediates plasticity and learning

statements.text: Feedforward activation likely does not mediate synaptic plasticity and learning, while recurrent processing of any extent does. In the theory this is the function recurrent feedback serves, together with feature binding.

sources.quote: It is likely that feedforward activation is not mediating synaptic plasticity and learning, while recurrent processing (of whatever extent) does do so
RPT: to enable plasticity, learning, and feature binding
